prompt_fields.subject: One large adult rat with a pointed muzzle, small round ears, four feet and one long naked tail. Ivory fur, alert half-upright front body, separated front paws and tail curling to the left.
prompt_fields.contrast: Existing brown rat is a compact low warm-brown mound. White rat must be light-valued with a tall triangular front silhouette; grey rat medium-valued with a wide low profile and an open tail shape. Do not use coat color alone.
prompt_fields.composition: One complete animal. Paws, ears and tail stay within the disc; avoid a tail crossing the upper-right UI margin. Make the muzzle and feet readable as broad separate shapes.
prompt_fields.palette: Muted ivory and warm bone shadows, soft pink-grey ears, clear darker facial features.
